dimensions.evidenceA: Preparation and meal occur before the arrest.
dimensions.evidenceB: Passover-eating concern appears after the arrest.
dimensions.label: Narrated time

dimensions.evidenceA: The day the Passover is sacrificed identifies preparation.
dimensions.evidenceB: Avoiding defilement is connected to eating Passover.
dimensions.label: Ritual marker

evidence.observation: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, the disciples ask where to prepare; Jesus later takes bread and the cup before they go to the Mount of Olives.
After the supper and arrest, John says Jesus’ accusers avoid defilement so that they may eat the Passover.

record.tension: Mark locates Passover preparation and meal before the arrest, while John places a stated intention to eat Passover after the supper and arrest.
record.title: When is the Passover meal eaten?
